analysis: All three produce competent, professional commit messages with no flowery filler, so calibration is high across the board. C edges ahead on style: subject + tightly scoped bullets + a single explanatory sentence, exactly the terse code-first shape expected â€” its only weakness is a subject line exceeding 72 chars. A is nearly as good with under-72 subject and clean bullets, but dilutes itself with a leading 'no format specified' preamble and a trailing explanatory paragraph. B is the weakest stylistically because its body is prose rather than bullets (explicitly penalized), though it partially recovers by offering a strong terse one-liner alternative.
